title: Circuit for a parity product
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number with $7\le m$. On the sign cube with $2^m$ coordinates, form $m$ pairs of blocks, each block having $m$ coordinates: for each $b=0,\ldots,m-1$, pair the coordinates $bm,\ldots,bm+m-1$ with the coordinates $m^2+bm,\ldots,m^2+bm+m-1$. Define the target function as the product, over these $m$ pairs, of the sign encoding of the dot product modulo $2$ of the two blocks. This function is computed by a depth-three circuit with at most $(2^m)^3$ internal gates and width at most $2m$.
hypotheses_covered: The target is defined on the sign cube with $2^m$ coordinates
